title: Instant scroll for long lists, smooth only for short distances
trigger: scrollIntoView smooth gây motion sickness trên long list khi distance lớn (panel open, seek far)
principle: scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }) phù hợp cho short distance (scroll vài item, user thấy context movement). Trên long list (hundreds/thousands items), smooth scroll animate qua toàn bộ list → motion sickness + disorientation. Default instant (behavior: 'auto') khi không biết beforehand distance.

cases.context: Side panel cue list scrollIntoView smooth từ top (scroll 0) đến middle (cue 500/1000) — animation dài → motion sickness

applyFor: Long list scroll (cue list, log viewer, chat history, file tree)
Panel open with pre-selected item (jump to item, not animate from top)
Any scrollIntoView trên list > 50 items where distance is unknown beforehand
